raw_html: [[Proof Against Poison| Proof Against Poison +6]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Proof Against Poison| Proof Against Poison +6]]:''' This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +6 [[Enhancement bonus]] to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 7 + their Fortitude save).
